newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Nuplex sees steady profit growth for year.
newsitem.headline: Nuplex sees steady profit growth for year.

text.p: Nuplex Industries Ltd said on Friday it was confident it could overcome the seasonal down-turn of the January holiday period, and the full year result would maintain the company's tradition of steady profit growth.
The company reported an 8.7 percent lift in net profit for the first half, to NZ$4.63 million from $4.26 million. It declared a dividend of 5.5 NZ cents per share, against 10 cps last year.
After the one-for-one bonus declared in November, this represented a 10 percent increase.
Nuplex said a supplementary dividend of 0.97 cps will also be paid. The dividend reinvestment plan will apply to this interim dividend.
Nuplex said the period included a full six months' trading of the hazardous waste treatment business acquired from Waste Management NZ compared to only one month in the same period last year.
It also included six months' trading of the medical waste treatment business purchased in April 1996 and two months trading for the recently acquired Plaster Systems business.

Additional turnover arising from the new businesses was countered by a significant drop in resin selling prices, following a fall in world petrochemical raw material costs, which were passed on to its customers.

The company said new businesses and increased penetration of the Australian market were the major contributors to the steady growth in profit, despite generally unfavourable market conditions in New Zealand and Australia.
Additional resource has been allocated to Asian exports and this aspect of the business is returning to good rates of growth in volume sales. -- Wellington Newsroom (64 4) 4734746
